newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.LANKA TEA EXPORTS TO LIBYA UP SHARPLY IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: S.LANKA TEA EXPORTS TO LIBYA UP SHARPLY IN 1997.

text.p: Sri Lanka's tea exports to Libya in the first six months of this year rose by 115.7 percent to 3.8 million kg, tea brokers Forbes and Walker Ltd said in their latest weekly market report.
The report, seen by Reuters on Monday, said exports to Libya in January-June 1996 were 1.76 million kg.
Libya's tea imports this year have been limited to tea in packets, it added.

Former Soviet republics have recorded the highest imports in the first six months of this year at 26.4 million kg, up from 21.4 million during the same period last year. Packeted tea accounted for a bulk 19.5 million kg, the report said.
The quantity of value added tea exports during the six-month period have risen by 5.9 percent, but that of bulk exports have only increased by 0.5 percent, the report added.
Customs figures show Sri Lanka's tea exports in June 1997 were 21.93 million kg, up 2.3 million kg in the same month last year.
